# Complete Representation Functions

Default language: English.

Localized agent indexes:

- /llms.en.txt: English agent index.
- /llms.zh-CN.txt: Chinese agent index.
- /llms-full.en.txt: English expanded agent context.
- /llms-full.zh-CN.txt: Chinese expanded agent context.

## Canonical Paper

- /paper/crf-paper.en.md: English paper version.
- /paper/crf-paper.zh-CN.md: Chinese original paper.
- /paper/crf-paper.md: Language selector.
- /paper/abstract.en.md: English abstract and contribution summary.
- /paper/abstract.zh-CN.md: Chinese abstract and contribution summary.
- /paper/claims.md: Claim index for review and verification.

## Machine-Readable Index

- /machine/crf.manifest.json: Top-level machine-readable CRF manifest.
- /machine/domain-registry.json: D1-D9 domain registry.
- /machine/keyword-table.json: Basis, operations, and keyword counts.
- /machine/theorem-map.json: Mathematical theorem sources for each domain.
- /machine/claim-graph.json: Claim-to-evidence graph.
- /machine/experiment-index.json: Experiment and reproducibility index.
- /machine/dlm-map.json: D×L×M runtime coordinate map.
- /machine/morphism-registry.json: Typed morphism registry.

## Agent Interface

- /AGENTS.md: Default English agent instruction file.
- /AGENTS.en.md: English agent instruction file.
- /AGENTS.zh-CN.md: Chinese agent instruction file.
- /docs/for-agents.md: Agent reading and review guide.
- /docs/mcp.md: MCP server resources, tools, prompts, and safety policy.
